hero.title: Know how your store is doing, at a glance.
hero.description: Your dashboard shows orders, earnings and returns for the period you pick, compared with the one before. Ask the Business Assistant anything else.

assistant.title: Ask about your store in plain words
assistant.description: What sold best this month? Which orders need you? When is the next payout? The assistant answers from your own sales, orders, stock and wallet, with charts when they help.

actions.title: It prepares the change. You tap Confirm.
actions.description: The assistant can get an action ready, like confirming an order, sending a quote, updating stock or creating a discount. Nothing happens until you confirm it.
points: Every change shown before it's made

digest.title: Your week, summed up every Sunday
digest.description: A short read on how the week went, with a few suggestions for what to do next. Each one links straight to the page where you can act on it.
points: A few sentences, not a report
Waiting in your console on Sunday

customers.title: See who buys from you
customers.description: Where your customers are, what they shop and who they are, with each customer's order history. Their contact details stay private.

closing.title: Turn Data Into Growth
closing.description: Your numbers, your customers and an assistant that knows your store. Spend less time guessing.
